verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents team comments, and @mentioning a teammate gives them access to the email thread itself, so a team can share and discuss individual conversations. A community user also mentions Workspaces/chat. However, nothing documents true shared inboxes or shared accounts where the whole team sees one conversation state, and community users say it lacks Front-style multi-inbox and were unsure Bundles could replace Team Inboxes. Missing for 10: documented shared or team inboxes, shared-account access, synchronized conversation state (assignment, done status) across teammates, and first-party docs for team channels or Workspaces.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state

citations.quote: Something special happens when you `@mention` a teammate in a comment – they suddenly get access to not just your comment, but the email too
Team comments let you privately discuss an email with your team directly in Shortwave, so you can plan how to respond together
